causes: Fungal infection caused by warm and humid weather in the Yala region.
Lack of essential soil nutrients such as nitrogen.
Planting infected seeds saved from previous harvests.
action_plan: Pluck off and burn the heavily browned leaves to stop spread.
Add well-rotted manure or wood ash around the plant bases to strengthen them.
Weed the farm thoroughly so sunshine and air reach the lower maize stalks.
prevention_tips: Rotate your maize with legumes like beans or cowpeas next season.
Always buy certified disease-resistant seeds for planting.
